about: Recall (plan-zeca M5): ten days of a developer's journal, and thirty questions about them, each with the day that answers it. hit@3: the day is among the first three passages. Six questions share no word with the day they ask about: what only a local embedding can answer.

days.summary: Set up the new laptop: installed Rust, Node 22 and the Tauri prerequisites, restored dotfiles, and configured the fish shell. Codex helped migrate the old zsh aliases.
lines: you: how do I move my zsh aliases to fish?
user allow Bash: rustup toolchain install stable

days.summary: Worked on the site: rewrote the pricing page in Astro, added a dark theme, and fixed broken links found by the link checker. Deployed a preview to Netlify.
lines: you: why does the pricing table overflow on phones?
user allow Bash: npx netlify deploy --dir dist

days.summary: Debugged a memory leak in the island: WebKit kept a closed window's web process alive. Measured about 110 MiB per window and wrote it down as a follow-up.
lines: you: why is memory still high after closing the Nest?
zeca: the closed webview's process lingers; WebKitGTK reuses it

days.summary: Paired the Android phone with the relay for the first time; signed approvals worked with the fingerprint. The QR code scan failed in low light until the contrast was raised.
lines: you: the phone won't read the QR code in my dark room
user deny Bash: adb shell rm -rf /sdcard/Download

days.summary: Spent the day on taxes and the household budget spreadsheet; no coding. Asked Zeca to compare two mortgage offers.
lines: you: compare a 30 year mortgage at 6.1% with a 20 year at 5.6%
zeca: the 20 year loan costs more each month but far less in interest

days.summary: Migrated the site's tests from Jest to Vitest. Two snapshot tests still fail because of date formatting; left them skipped with a TODO.
lines: you: vitest says toMatchSnapshot differs only in the date
user allow Bash: npm uninstall jest ts-jest

days.summary: Reviewed a pull request from a contributor that adds Spanish translations; asked for changes to three strings. Merged the Postgres upgrade to version 17 on the api project after the migration passed in staging.
lines: you: is it safe to run the pg_upgrade on staging first?

days.summary: Chased flaky CI on GitHub Actions: the Windows runner timed out building whisper. Cached the cmake build and the job went from 14 to 6 minutes.
lines: you: the windows job keeps timing out on whisper-rs-sys
user allow Bash: gh run rerun 1234 --failed

days.summary: Wrote the release notes for 0.1.6 and published the AUR package; a user reported the tray icon is blurry on a 4K screen, filed as an issue.
Prepared the talk for the local Rust meetup about building a desktop pet with Tauri; made twelve slides and a live demo of the island.
lines: you: give me an outline for a 20 minute talk on Tauri
zeca: start with the problem, then the architecture, then a live demo
